Maya: Quick check — final run-of-show + mic rota for next Wed webinar? Can we lock timings today?
Anya: Yep — speakers confirmed. greenroom at 10:00 PT, stage at 10:25 PT. Need 5min each for mic-checks. @Maya remind speakers to bring a non-public demo token. :mic:
Sam: For the benchmark segment, order matters — I'd prefer we show cost-first then latency, customers get the economics story quicker. also want a short slide that calls out dataset + prompt used.
Leo: Agree on order. Tech note: for live demo use the cached KV-enabled variant so we don't spike token costs. Fallback plan: point at staging-proxy with model id `redwood-bench-v1` if live shows instability.
Leo: Proxy config snippet (for ops):
```
proxy_target: staging-proxy.redwood-infer:443
model: redwood-bench-v1
cache_prefix: demo-2026-03
timeout_ms: 45000
```
Maya: Here's the proposed run-of-show (short):
```
10:00 - greenroom (speakers + ops)
10:25 - stage intro (Maya) 3m
10:28 - Benchmark narrative & slide (Sam) 5m
10:33 - Live demo 8m (Leo runs two sequences: 1) cost-optimized inference, 2) end-to-end latency)
10:41 - Customer story + Q&A 12m
10:53 - Close + CTA + lead routing callout (Ben) 7m
```
Ben: On lead routing — I'll add UTM params and ensure HubSpot form routes to the webinar sequence. Quick ask: do we want separate routing for demo trials vs general leads?
Sam: Yes — split demos into a "trial" workflow so SDRs can prioritize. Add a hidden field on the form `interest=demo` so we can trigger the higher-touch flow.
Anya: Rehearsal logistics: can we do a 30-min full run tomorrow at 9:30 PT? I'll own call invites and send a slide order doc. Also need presenters to upload slides to the shared drive by EOD today.
Leo: 9:30 PT works. For the rehearsal, please give ops the exact endpoint to test — I'll run the smoke script. Also planning to pre-warm the model and run a KV-cache priming sequence.
Maya: Assigning rehearsal: @Anya please send invites to speakers + ops. @Leo we'll use `staging-proxy.redwood-infer` for rehearsal; fallback `redwood-bench-v1-quant` if needed.
deploy-bot: Calendar invites scheduled and sent to 12 guests (automated).
Ben: I'll update the registration CTA copy to call out the economics section and the optional trial. Drafting now, will post in channel in 20m. :thumbsup:
Maya: Perfect — if everyone can confirm slides uploaded by 6pm PT, we can lock the run. Thanks!
